findings.title: Traceability still declares current round-8 regeneration pending although the package and next section declare it complete
findings.requirement: Historical/current traceability and reader-visible status must be unambiguous and must not retain a stale pending statement after completed current-digest regeneration. Round-8 correction clause R8-C08 specifically requires unambiguous evidence currentness.
evidence: review/requirements-traceability.md §10 says: ‘The later round-8 formal edit supersedes those normative bytes, so only the current round-8 status below declares regeneration pending.’
The immediately following §11 says: ‘The schema-3 candidate-only material graph now matches the current PLAN and manifest digests and dynamically covers all 28 current headings.’
README.md says round-8 regeneration is ‘complete for the current PLAN and normative-manifest digests,’ and review/round-8-resolution.md says the graph matches the current digests and all 28 headings.

Independent recomputation confirms PLAN SHA-256 9f3ecb1f4dc2540872cbf66e8a8ab382574e681fb153180533eeef64acab8be5 and manifest SHA-256 8fb44b75c774f6e4da9c1bbb1407617158538e685811ea43d5ea8c2c3ff6b6b2 match material-claims.json; all 28 dynamically enumerated headings match its ordered coverage set.
findings.impact: The authoritative requirements/status register gives mutually exclusive answers about whether the current round-8 editorial regeneration is pending or complete. This is the same class of stale-currentness contradiction R8-C08 was meant to close and can mislead a reader about the package's remaining gates.
findings.required_plan_repair: In review/requirements-traceability.md §10, replace ‘so only the current round-8 status below declares regeneration pending’ with historical/current wording that says the round-8 regeneration completed and that §11 is authoritative for the current checkpoint. Preserve the separate pending future gates: immutable re-fetch, human semantic review, reviewed-edge regeneration, implementation/model proof, and independent closure. Because this is traceability-only text, no PLAN/manifest digest or material-graph regeneration is needed. Re-run independent plan-only closure audit.
